blockingDefect.ruling: All nine headword occurrences are narrator-governed descriptions of someone making a circle. Under the public actor rule, MasterName is the utterer of the headword, not the person whose action the narrator describes. The decision instead promotes each circle performer to exactActor.masterName or treats the performer as the anonymous headword actor. That would recreate the narrated-action attribution defect.
blockingDefect.requiredModel: For each occurrence, record the exact headword-bearing grammar as narrated/impersonal with MasterName null and a complete ActorAttribution. Store the person who draws the circle separately as ContextMasters or ContextActors with an allowed contextual role and explicit GrammarEvidence. Respondents and record owners remain contextual people.
